snippet.title: Crazy Taxi: World Tour | Welcome to the West Coast
snippet.description:
Buckle up and enjoy all the sights that the West Coast has to offer.  From sandy beaches to beautiful hilltops, there's no better way to explore than by taxi.  Explore the West Coast today!
 
Sign up for a chance to participate in the Multiplayer Closed Network Test by August 31st, 2026 at:
 
https://www.sega.com/crazy-taxi/crazy-taxi-world-tour?tab=closed-network-test

Join the Discord and learn more about getting priority access: https://discord.com/invite/crazytaxi
 
Wishlist Now on XBOX Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and Steam
